summary: Both changes match the spec. The hand.ts diff adds only comment lines: the SPEC-04 grep finds no non-comment lines (exit 1) and foldOut's logic is unchanged. The comment covers all three §5 points (the reset rule matching endRound, why it resets via gather / no betting round / actions kept, and a pointer to the test), and the SPEC-03 grep prints 3. The new acceptance test checks the pre-fold values [8, 2] before checking the reset to 0/0, plus street, toAct, endedBy and every streetContribution. The flop case also checks the exact awards. If foldOut kept the street's values, both tests would fail, so they are not tautologies. The test helpers copy the review-gaps pattern as A-2 allows. The new test passes (2/2) and the build-1 gates are green. No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings.
